description: Make a time block come back on chosen weekdays. Two ways: pass `block_id` to turn an EXISTING block into a recurring one (it becomes the first occurrence and keeps its title, duration and fixed time — do this when the block is already on the timeline, otherwise that day would get it twice), or describe a new one (title, duration, optional fixed time) starting on `start_date`. Nothing is created on the timeline right away: each day's block appears when that day is opened in the app or listed with list_day_blocks. With `anchor_time` the block sits at that hour every day; without it, it is placed from the user's wake time and shifts with it.

anchor_time.description: Fixed wall-clock hour HH:MM. Omit for a block that follows the wake time.

block_id.description: Existing block to repeat (from list_day_blocks). When given, title/type/duration/anchor/start_date are taken from that block.

duration_minutes.description: Duration in minutes (default 30 for an activity, 60 for a bucket)

start_date.description: First day the rule applies (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today (UTC). Pass the user's local date when you know it.

type.description: 'block' = activity (default). 'tasks' = a recurring task bucket (e.g. a daily "Writing" window the day's tasks go into).

weekdays.description: ISO weekdays the block comes back on: 1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday. Every day = [1,2,3,4,5,6,7]; working week = [1,2,3,4,5].

name: create_recurring_block
